answer: Anchor each identity to a licensed pilot's logbook: the authority issues one license per person, and every logged hour is countersigned by an instructor or operator. A pilot must also hold a current medical certificate and pass a biennial flight review, so a dormant alias lapses on its own. Forging a hundred pilots means paying for a hundred training courses, medical exams, and flight hours - the nectar of cheap Sybils turns to stone. The ivory tower of fake logbooks collapses when the authority checks one license number, and the opal sheen of a copied certificate fades under the same check.
